description: This file defines a selector generator for DOM elements, providing functions to create CSS and XPath-like selectors with scoring and ranking mechanisms, used for element identification in testing or automation frameworks.

methods.name: generateSelector
methods.description: Main function to generate a CSS selector for a target element based on options, returning the selector string, list of selectors, and matching elements.

methods.name: generateSelectorFor
methods.description: Generates a specific selector token array for a given element, considering text and no-text candidates, and nested parent selectors.

methods.name: buildNoTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on attributes, IDs, labels, roles, and other properties, excluding text content.

methods.name: buildTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on text content, labels, ARIA roles, and other textual attributes.

methods.name: makeSelectorForId
methods.description: Creates a CSS selector for an element ID, using a simple ID selector if possible.

methods.name: hasCSSIdToken
methods.description: Checks if a set of selector tokens includes a CSS ID selector.

methods.name: cssFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback CSS selector path for an element based on ID, class, and position.

methods.name: penalizeScoreForLength
methods.description: Adjusts selector token scores based on their length to prefer shorter, more precise selectors.

methods.name: joinTokens
methods.description: Joins an array of selector tokens into a string representation.

methods.name: combineScores
methods.description: Calculates a combined score for a set of selector tokens, lower scores are better.

methods.name: isGuidLike
methods.description: Detects if an ID string resembles a GUID based on character transitions.

methods.name: trimWordBoundary
methods.description: Trims a string to a maximum length at a word boundary.

methods.name: suitableTextAlternatives
methods.description: Provides alternative text snippets with scoring bonuses for better selector robustness.

methods.name: escapeNodeName
methods.description: Escapes node names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: escapeClassName
methods.description: Escapes class names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: cssEscapeCharacter
methods.description: Escapes individual characters for CSS identifiers.
